caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown-colored horse in a leaping or running position with all four legs extended. The horse's body shows various shades of brown, with lighter and darker streaks giving a sense of texture and muscle definition. The hooves, legs, tail, and head are proportionally rendered, and the mouth is slightly open. There is a small, vertical, black element hanging from the horse’s belly, resembling a rod or support. The background is plain and off-white with no additional objects or scenery, making the horse the sole subject of the composition.
title: Running Horse Weather Vane
